name: Starkus & Radzevičius
description:
STARKUS & RADZEVIČIUS – PO 20 METŲ

At the end of 2006, two friends, Martynas Starkus and Vytaras Radzevičius, got into an old Mercedes and set off on a journey to Africa. Vytaras drove, while Martynas filmed. After returning to Lithuania, their journey soon appeared on LRT as a travel series called Afrika LT.
What seemed like it could have been just a few episodes of television unexpectedly became the beginning of something much bigger. The new travel format became a huge success and, over the past 20 years, Starkus and Radzevičius have become some of the most recognisable figures in Lithuanian travel television.

Their unique, funny and sometimes dramatic travel experiences have reached audiences not only through television, but also through books, podcasts and countless live meetings with their fans. Twenty years later, Martynas continues to travel and create the popular TV show Tai Kur Toliau?, while Vytaras, now living surrounded by the forests of Dzūkija, shares his experiences of life in nature through his popular Vytaro Ferma.

“Po 20 metų” is a special opportunity for the two friends to meet again, look back at the adventures they experienced together and share stories from their lives and travels today. Expect plenty of laughter, funny stories, unexpected situations, improvisation and the opportunity for the audience to ask questions and hear the answers directly from the duo.

A fantastic evening of good humour and great stories is guaranteed!

Please also note that the event will be photographed and filmed.
